case_title: Key account order with inbound buffer already scanned
exception_description: Key-account order KA-6510 includes a critical spare part. WMS shows 4 units in the forward bin, the last count was 12 hours ago, and a small inbound batch has already been scanned at receiving but not yet put away. AI recommends releasing the order from current stock.
layer1_visible: Key-account order KA-6510 includes a critical spare part. WMS shows 4 units in the forward bin, the last count was 12 hours ago, and a small inbound batch has already been scanned at receiving but not yet put away. AI recommends releasing the order from current stock.
detail_expand: The customer has a same-day service commitment, so a miss triggers account escalation. Emergency transfer stock exists at another site, but pulling it now would create premium handling and risk duplicate allocation. The case is high risk because of account importance, not because all evidence points against the AI plan.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends releasing from current stock because the scanned inbound buffer makes a true shortage unlikely and avoids a costly emergency transfer.

decision_options.action_label: Pause to verify receiving scan and open allocations
Request emergency transfer from another site

current_disruptions.description: WMS stock count may not match physical pick-bin quantity

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: The evidence supports trust even under high stakes because the inbound buffer is already visible to the system.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores receiving-scan ID, allocation status, and approval decision.
traceability_text.uncertainty_trigger2: Inbound batch scanned but not put away
traceability_text.recommended_check: Check the receiving scan and open-allocation queue before release.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The spare part was available as expected, so the order cleared without the need for premium recovery action.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The check confirmed the same availability, but the manual review and holding time were expensive under the account commitment.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: The emergency transfer was unnecessary and created premium handling without reducing real risk.
